draft.title: Classifying quadrilaterals
card: A quadrilateral has four straight sides. A parallelogram has two pairs of parallel sides. Its opposite sides are equal, its opposite angles are equal, and its diagonals cut each other in half.
a parallelogram with four right angles. Its diagonals are equal in length.
a parallelogram with four equal sides. Its diagonals cross at right angles.
has four equal sides and four right angles, so it is both a rectangle and a rhombus. A kite has two pairs of equal sides next to each other. A trapezium has at least one pair of parallel sides.
draft.remember: Rectangles, rhombuses and squares are all parallelograms. A square has the properties of both a rectangle and a rhombus.

a.q: Which quadrilateral is a parallelogram with four equal sides and diagonals that cross at right angles?
a.why: A rhombus is a parallelogram with four equal sides, and its diagonals cross at right angles. A rectangle is a parallelogram too, but its sides are not always all equal and its diagonals do not always cross at right angles.
a.clue: Think about which parallelogram has all sides equal.

b.q: Mia draws a quadrilateral with two pairs of parallel sides and four right angles. Its sides are not all equal. What is it?
opts: A rectangle that is not a square
A rhombus that is not a square
A trapezium with no equal sides
b.why: Two pairs of parallel sides make it a parallelogram, and four right angles make it a rectangle. A square would need four equal sides too, and Mia's sides are not all equal, so it is a rectangle that is not a square.
b.clue: A square needs all sides equal, and these are not.

b.best: A rectangle that is not a square
